pages.title: Contact Alberta AI
pages.lead: **Contact Alberta** is a Government of Alberta AI agent that answers Albertans’ general questions by voice or text, using published government sources only.

items.label: conversations a year answerable from published knowledge

blocks.note: About 2.5 million conversations a year, sorted by need. Source: contact centre assessment of one year of case records, 12 months to September 2026.

blocks.text: Real questions from 1,000 recorded calls. Each side is scored alone, with the same method, on questions kept back from all tuning.

items.title: Correct information, strict check
items.text: A call counts as correct when no statement is proven wrong by a live official page. 336 calls.

items.title: Correct information, blind grading
items.text: A grader scores each answer without knowing who gave it. 675 questions.

blocks.text: Contact Alberta can offer value to Albertans, addressing their questions day and night.
blocks.small: The general questions in the assessment need no ministry system and no person to answer.

blocks.text: Two models make the AI agent both quick and careful. A **fast talker** replies at once and decides what to look up. A **slow thinker** writes the answer from the sources.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: A live speech engine turns speech into text

steps.title: Reply
steps.text: The fast talker, in Montréal, replies and starts the search

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Published documents and a map of 70 topics

steps.title: Answer
steps.text: The slow thinker writes from the sources only

steps.title: Check
steps.text: Code checks every number against a source

steps.title: Speak
steps.text: A natural voice speaks the answer

blocks.text: The whole alberta.ca sitemap, the official forms, and handbooks and laws found from real questions. No AI-written text.

items: More than 30 speech engines tested on the same recorded calls
A free model on a government machine matched the Montréal cloud service: about 8 word errors in 100
The local model costs about 1 cent an hour of audio, against about 1 dollar
Engines that write words on silent audio are not used

blocks.text: The project builds toward evaluating AI agents through thousands of tests, hill climbing toward one hundred percent across all meaningful metrics. **Hill climbing** means measuring, changing one thing, and keeping the change only when the measure improves.

items.title: Future integration
items.label: Connections to ministry case systems, which more than half of conversations need. File checks only for callers with a verified Alberta.ca Account.

items.title: Knowledge growth
items.label: The next 10,000 recordings show which published documents answer real questions. Documents join the knowledge base by written rule.

blocks.text: **Figures.** The deployed setting of the AI agent. Correct information and statements: real questions kept back from all tuning, both sides checked against live official pages; the staff side is a de-identified summary of what was said on the call. Speed: 60 spoken questions. Simulated calls: an AI plays an invented caller; the AI agent is the real system. Results are reported by program, never by employee.
